keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Job search keywords, e.g. ["software engineer", "data analyst"]. Builds https://www.reed.co.uk/jobs/<keywords>-jobs URLs.

searchUrls.title: Search URLs (optional)
searchUrls.description: Full Reed.co.uk search URLs to scrape instead of / in addition to keywords.

maxPages.title: Max pages per search
maxPages.description: Number of result pages per search (25 jobs per page, ?pageno=N).

maxJobs.title: Max jobs total
maxJobs.description: Overall cap on jobs pushed to the dataset.
